note: Only geometry is used. Textures, materials and source files are never bundled; each model is decimated, normalised and quantised by tools/prepare-assets.py into src/assets/<name>.geo, which the single-file build embeds. All three models were sourced on Sketchfab. Adam Pollock confirmed on 27 September 2026 that each allows public and commercial use, including the Timber Frame House.
